'''Pit Cornburr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:UB" /> Following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he worked for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] support staff as a maintenance worker in the [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, scientists were secretly conducting dangerous scientific research for the Empire, intending to re-engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] into a [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]].<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> he was present when an accident took place in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility and the virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|escaped]] containment.<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> Cornburr and most of the people in the [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|area]] fell victim to the Blackwing virus, and turned into [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] manifestations. Pit Cornburr's undead body was controlled by the virus and kept walking around in the Imperial Research and Prison Facility until it was destroyed by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] at the deepest level of the research facility.<ref name="SWG:UB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Pit Cornburr was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:UB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Pit Cornburr was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|Game Update 14]]," released on [[October 12]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>

Examining Pit Cornburr simply identified him as Cornburr,<ref name="SWG:UB" /> but one of the computer readouts in the facility listed his full name as Pit Cornburr.<ref name="SWG:RFL1" /> He was one of the [[:w:c:swg:Undead Boss|Undead boss enemies]] in the Quarantine Zone that players have to kill to complete a [[:w:c:swg:Collection|collection]].<ref name="SWG:UB" />
